# Source Trail Auditor 1.0.0

First stable release of the research-audit Skill for AI-assisted web research.

Use the Skill to split a draft into atomic claims, map each claim to checked evidence, distinguish official action pages from background reading, identify freshness and source-independence gaps, and produce a prioritized verification route.

Assets include the iPolloWork installer, a standalone Skill ZIP, source ZIP, and SHA-256 checksums.
